user: You can now silence wikiman in any project without losing its wiki: /wiki:disconnect pauses context injection, staleness prompts, and auto-recap while keeping docs/wiki/ on disk; /wiki:reconnect turns it back on.
what: Added /wiki:disconnect and /wiki:reconnect commands. Disconnect stops context injection, staleness checks/prompts, end-of-turn recap, /wiki:update, and /wiki:init for that folder; the docs/wiki/ bundle stays untouched, the viewer and lookup tools keep working. Reconnect resumes everything.
why: Some projects don't want a live wiki nagging (archives, vendored code, short experiments) but deleting the bundle loses accumulated knowledge — disconnect/reconnect separates "stop being proactive" from "remove the wiki".
next: Run /wiki:disconnect in a folder you want quiet, /wiki:reconnect to resume. New commands need a fresh session or /reload to appear.
summary: Added DISCONNECTED_FILE registry (~/.pi/agent/.wiki-disconnected.json, mirrors omitted-registry pattern) with load/save/isDisconnected helpers; guards in session_start (footer 'wiki: disconnected', skips init-ask + staleness), before_agent_start (no injection), agent_end (no recap, pending timer cancelled), /wiki:update and /wiki:init (refuse with hint). /wiki viewer and wiki_* tools remain usable.
